annotations.title: Rank the best use of a property

description: Screen ONE property across every strategy the provided inputs qualify for and rank them by deal score — answers "what is the best use of this property?". Provide a superset of inputs (price, marketRent, adr, occupancy, rehabBudget, arv, units, …); strategies missing inputs are skipped with reasons. All rates/percents are FRACTIONS (0.0675 = 6.75%). Omitted operating inputs are filled with documented defaults and listed in assumptions.estimated_fields. Free, no key.

inputs.description: Deal inputs in camelCase engine keys. Anything omitted gets a documented default, listed back under assumptions.estimated_fields. Send a SUPERSET across strategies — whatever you know. Strategies missing their required fields are skipped with a reason rather than failing the call.

adr.description: Average nightly rate in dollars. Required for str.

arv.description: After-repair value in dollars. Required for brrr and flip.

btsArv.description: Finished build-to-sell value in dollars. Required for newc.

buildPsf.description: Build cost per square foot in dollars. Required for newc.

downPct.description: Down payment. Expressed as a FRACTION (0.0675 = 6.75%), never a percent. Optional — a documented default applies.

landPrice.description: Land acquisition cost in dollars. Required for newc.

livingSqft.description: Heated living area in square feet. Required for newc.

marketRent.description: Expected monthly rent in dollars. Required for ltr and brrr.

occupancy.description: Expected occupancy. Expressed as a FRACTION (0.0675 = 6.75%), never a percent. Required for str.

price.description: Purchase price in dollars. Required for every strategy except newc.

rate.description: Annual interest rate. Expressed as a FRACTION (0.0675 = 6.75%), never a percent. Optional.

rehabBudget.description: Renovation budget in dollars. Required for brrr and flip.

taxes.description: Annual property taxes in dollars. Optional.

units.description: Multifamily rent roll — {unitCount, avgRent, marketRent?} or an array of unit objects. Required for multifamily.

vacancyPct.description: Vacancy allowance. Expressed as a FRACTION (0.0675 = 6.75%), never a percent. Optional.

name: best_use

data_note.description: REIzer data tools that can refine this analysis (needs an API key).

disclaimer.description: Not financial advice — software estimate only.
